title: Intro to Swift
line: Optionals, structs and closures, then your first SwiftUI view.

project.title: A coin toss app
project.brief: Make an app in Xcode on your own. An enum for heads and tails, a Tally struct with a mutating toss method, and a SwiftUI view that shows both counts with a button to toss again.
checks: The project builds in Xcode with no errors
The view keeps the tally in a property marked @State
A button action calls toss and the view shows both counts

lessons.title: Run your first Swift program
lessons.goal: Teach a complete beginner to make a Command Line Tool project in Xcode, write a three-item packing list with print in main.swift and run it.
lessons.passes: The Xcode console shows the three lines of the packing list.

lessons.title: Let, var and string interpolation
lessons.goal: Teach Swift let, var, type inference and string interpolation by building a running pace calculator from a distance in kilometres and a time in minutes.
lessons.passes: 10 km in 55 minutes prints a pace of 5.5 minutes per km.

lessons.title: If, switch and loops
lessons.goal: Teach Swift if, switch over ranges and for in loops by printing a postage price table for parcels from 1 to 10 kilograms.
lessons.passes: Ten rows print, one per kilogram, each with its price.

lessons.title: Functions and argument labels
lessons.goal: Teach Swift functions with argument labels, default values and return types by writing a hotel stay price function called with and without a nightly rate.
lessons.passes: Three nights at the default rate of 80 prints 240.

lessons.title: Arrays and dictionaries
lessons.goal: Teach Swift arrays and dictionaries, with append, count, subscripts and for in, by building a school timetable of subjects and the room for each.
lessons.passes: Each subject prints with its room, in the order of the array.

lessons.title: Optionals
lessons.goal: Teach Swift optionals with if let, guard let and the nil coalescing operator by writing a locker lookup that handles a missing student and a bad number.
lessons.passes: A known name prints its locker, an unknown one a default, with no force unwrap.

lessons.title: Structs
lessons.goal: Teach Swift structs with properties, a computed property and a mutating method by building a Bus that boards riders and reports the seats left.
lessons.passes: A 40 seat bus prints 28 seats left after 12 riders board.

lessons.title: Enums
lessons.goal: Teach Swift enums with cases, raw values and switch by building a compass with a method that turns right from north to east to south to west.
lessons.passes: Four right turns from north print east, south, west and north.

lessons.title: Closures
lessons.goal: Teach Swift closures and trailing closure syntax with sorted, filter and map by listing mountains over 4000 metres from tallest to shortest.
lessons.passes: Only mountains over 4000 m print, tallest first.

lessons.title: Your first SwiftUI view
lessons.goal: Teach a first SwiftUI view in a new Xcode App project, with VStack, Text, Button and an @State property, by building a tap counter.
lessons.passes: ContentView has an @State count and a Button that adds one to it.
